name: signal-domain-signal-cannot-connect-to-a-fluid-port
source:
COMPONENT SigConst(out)
  PARAM k
  out.sig = k
END
COMPONENT SigGain(in, out)
  PARAM k
  out.sig = k * in.sig
END
COMPONENT SigSum(in1, in2, out)
  out.sig = in1.sig + in2.sig
END
SigConst SRC(k=100000)
Source   S(fluid$=Air, mdot=1, P=100000, T=300)
Sink     K()
connect(SRC.out, K.in)
connect(S.out, K.in)

error.message: connect(src.out, k.in): cannot connect a signal port (src.out) to a fluid port (k.in) — different physical domains. Couple domains through a transducer component (a motor, pump, heating resistor, …), not a direct connect.
